summary: Iteration 27 — Orrbbit transactional email sender + shared-layout logo — all 19 backend tests PASS. Verified: logo asset served correctly (200, image/png, 50351 bytes) with immutable Cache-Control at the origin; path traversal blocked (encoded and plain); shared email layout in all 3 spot-checked templates (welcome, password_reset, pro_approved) contains /api/email-assets/orrbbit-logo.png + alt="ORRBBIT", NO old 'Orrbb<span' wordmark, plain-text starts with 'ORRBBIT'; ONE live send to delivered+iter27_<uuid>@resend.dev via /api/control/email/templates/welcome/test succeeded with resend_id, and Resend API cross-check confirms from='ORRBBIT <notifications@updates.orrbbit.com>', reply_to=['support@orrbbit.com'], html contains logo URL; fresh user registration logs BOTH verify_email + welcome events as status=sent; /api/control/email/templates returns 56 templates; demo-login works; /api/users/me/email-preferences works; RESEND_API_KEY 're_V4' snippet never appears in /email/stats, /email/events, template previews, or a failed-send response body. Live sends kept to minimum (1 explicit + 2 from a single fresh registration, all to Resend's delivered@resend.dev test address).

minor.issue: Backend correctly emits Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable (verified via localhost:8001) but the Cloudflare/K8s ingress rewrites it to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' on the preview domain. Not an app bug — mail clients typically hit the deployed backend URL (PUBLIC_BASE_URL/orrbbit.com) directly, where CF cache rules may differ. Worth confirming the header passes through in the production ingress so email clients cache the logo aggressively.

action_items: (Optional) Confirm the production ingress preserves the app-level Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable header on /api/email-assets/*; the preview ingress rewrites it to no-store which would defeat mail-client caching.
critical_code_review_comments: email_service.EmailService.email_asset() correctly uses os.path.basename(filename) to strip traversal — path-traversal tests confirm 404 for '..%2F..%2F.env' and '../server.py'.
EmailService._deliver() correctly redacts the API key from failure messages (body.replace(self._api_key, '***')); confirmed no 're_V4' leakage anywhere.
email_templates.render_layout() renders a single inside the shared layout — all 56 templates inherit it (spot-checked 3 including a mandatory + a preference-gated + a professional template).
Plain-text version starts with 'ORRBBIT\n\n' as expected (was the old text wordmark before).

email_service.EmailService uses os.environ['FROM_EMAIL'] / FROM_NAME / SUPPORT_EMAIL — no hardcoded senders; Resend delivery from='ORRBBIT <notifications@updates.orrbbit.com>' and reply_to=['support@orrbbit.com'] confirmed on live send.
seed_data_creation: One fresh user delivered+iter27_<uuid>@resend.dev created for regression check. Teardown attempts hard-delete via /api/control/users — best-effort. Total live sends: 3 to Resend's delivered@resend.dev test address (1 explicit welcome test + verify_email + welcome from registration). No emails sent to k97davies@icloud.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter27 covers the logo asset + shared-layout migration. Reusable regression: test_iter27_email_logo.py — needs EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env. Note the '+' in email addresses is treated as a regex quantifier by /api/control/email/events?email=<x> — test queries via template filter and client-side filters instead. Preview domain rewrites Cache-Control to no-store; check backend directly on localhost:8001 to see app-level header.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all review items verified as working. The only observation is an environment-level Cache-Control header override by the ingress/CF on the preview domain that does not affect production behaviour.
